name: resource-broker

plugins.name: resource-broker
plugins.description: A bulletin board that keeps concurrent Claude Code sessions on one machine from fighting over finite resources: declare before you use, stay visible to everyone else. It never blocks a command, never inspects a resource, and never interprets a declaration. Hooks can be silenced with RESOURCE_BROKER_DISABLE. Note: the CLI output, hook notices and design docs are in Japanese. ／ 同じマシンで動く複数の Claude Code セッションが有限資源を取り合わないための掲示板。
